text: The ID will handle the layout design of the remote, and the User Interface Designer will design a menu for all functions and create a page-based menu.
One participant reported that their computer is not functioning properly.
The Project Manager will organize project maps/minutes into three groups.
The product will be targeted at users below forty, with an option to also target the current customer group.

No teletext functionality will be included; branding requirements mandate logo and colours reflecting corporate identity, with the logo positioned relative to the screen, and a two-tier function approach for simple public use and advanced options for younger users, with a 16-40 age focus.
